plugins.name: daily-board
plugins.description: A daily must-do board above the Claude Code prompt: goals, counters, toggles and checklists, with an optional gate that locks build tools until the counters are met.

plugins.name: usage-panel
plugins.description: A side panel that shows Claude Code usage in color: context window by category, plan limits, session cost and tokens, daily totals, and MCP and tool calls.
